databaseName: Section 5 - SageMaker Algorithms: Input formats and File/Pipe mode

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Linear Learner`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: RecordIO-protobuf (Float32 only), CSV (first column label, then features). Both `file` and `pipe` mode are supported.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `XGBoost`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: CSV, libsvm, recordIO-protobuf, Parquet (AWS extended). Distributed GPU (XGBoost 1.5) only works with CSV or Parquet. File and pipe mode typically supported; check docs for specific version.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `LightGBM`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: text/CSV only (required for training and inference); same format for training and validation. File and pipe mode support: see AWS docs (not explicitly stated in source).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Seq2Seq`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: RecordIO-protobuf (tokens as integers), with vocabulary files; must provide training data, validation data, and vocabulary files. File/pipe: see AWS docs (not explicitly stated in source).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `DeepAR`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: JSON Lines (jsonl), gzip or parquet. Each record must have start (timestamp) and target (time series values); can include dynamic_feat and cat (categorical). File/pipe: see AWS docs (not explicitly stated in source).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `BlazingText`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: For text classification — one sentence per line, first word __Label__ followed by label; also augmented manifest text format. For Word2Vec — text file with one training sentence per line. File/pipe: see AWS docs (not explicitly stated in source).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Object2Vec`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: Tokenized data (integers); training data is pairs or sequences of tokens (e.g. JSON with label, in0, in1 arrays). File/pipe: see AWS docs (not explicitly stated in source).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Object Detection`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: MXNet — RecordIO or Image format (jpg, png) with a JSON file for annotations per image. TensorFlow — determined by underlying model. File/pipe: see AWS docs (not explicitly stated in source).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Image Classification`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: MXNet/TensorFlow — typically RecordIO or image format (e.g. 3-channel 224x224); details depend on framework and mode. File/pipe: see AWS docs (source skipped input details).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Semantic Segmentation`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: jpg or png with annotations; label maps for annotations. Augmented manifest image format supported for Pipe Mode. Inference: JPG accepted. Both `file` and `pipe` supported (pipe via augmented manifest).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Neural Topic Model (NTM)`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: RecordIO-protobuf or CSV (tokenized; each document has word counts for vocabulary). Train channel required; validation, test, auxiliary optional. Both `file` and `pipe` mode supported.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Random Cut Forest (RCF)`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: RecordIO-protobuf or CSV. Optional test channel for accuracy, precision, recall, F1 on labeled data. Both `file` and `pipe` mode supported.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `LDA (Latent Dirichlet Allocation)`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: RecordIO-protobuf or CSV (tokenized; each document has counts for every word in vocabulary). Train channel required, optional test channel. `Pipe` mode only supported with recordIO; `file` mode supported for both recordIO and CSV.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `KNN`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: recordIO-protobuf or CSV (first column is label). Train and test channels. Both `file` and `pipe` mode supported on either channel.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `K-Means`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: recordIO-protobuf or CSV. Train channel (ShardedByS3Key), optional test (FullyReplicated). Both `file` and `pipe` supported on either.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `PCA (Principal Component Analysis)`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: recordIO-protobuf or CSV. Both `file` and `pipe` mode supported.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `Factorization Machines`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: recordIO-protobuf with Float32 only; CSV is not available (sparse data). File/pipe: typically both supported for recordIO; see AWS docs.

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: What are the input file format for `IP Insights`?, Is `pipe`/`file` supported?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Input formats: CSV only — entity and IP columns (e.g. user names, account IDs). Training channel required, optional validation (AUC). File/pipe: see AWS docs (not explicitly stated in source).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: Which algorithms support `pipe`?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Linear Learner, Random Cut Forest (RCF), Neural Topic Model (NTM), Semantic Segmentation (augmented manifest image for pipe), LDA (pipe only with recordIO, not with CSV), KNN, K-Means, PCA (Principal Component Analysis).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: Which algorithms do not support `pipe`?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Pipe support is not stated in the source for: XGBoost, LightGBM, Seq2Seq, DeepAR, BlazingText, Object2Vec, Object Detection, Image Classification, Factorization Machines, IP Insights. (Check AWS docs for current support.)
